step1_analysis.circuit_type: Switched-Capacitor Sampling Network and Clock Buffer
step1_analysis.description: A sub-circuit of a switched-capacitor resonator, containing an inverter-based clock buffer with a reduced high-level output (via an NMOS supply transistor XM4) driving a sampling switch (XM6), and an additional switched-capacitor sampling branch (XM1, XM3).

paper_reference.title: A 80-MHz Bandpass Sigma-Delta Modulator for a 100-MHz IF Receiver

buffer_delay.description: Propagation delay from the clock input (N1) to the buffered clock output (N0).

sky130_expected.calculation: Delay is determined by the RC time constant of the inverter (XM2, XM5) driving the gate capacitance of XM6. With W=5um and L=0.5um, gate capacitance is ~5fF. Delay should be very small.
sky130_expected.reasoning: In 130nm technology, a 5um wide transistor driving a similar sized load will have a delay in the tens to hundreds of picoseconds.

buffer_voh.description: Maximum high voltage level of the buffered clock (N0).

sky130_expected.calculation: The inverter supply is provided by XM4 (NMOS) with gate at VDD (1.8V). The source (N3) will be at VDD - Vth_nmos. Vth_nmos is ~0.42V, plus body effect.
sky130_expected.reasoning: The NMOS pass transistor drops the supply voltage by a threshold voltage, limiting the maximum swing of the clock buffer to reduce charge injection or clock feedthrough.

power_consumption.description: Average power consumption of the sub-circuit during 80 MHz operation.

sky130_expected.calculation: Dynamic power P = f * C * V^2. f = 80 MHz, V = 1.8V, C is parasitic (~20fF). P = 80e6 * 20e-15 * 1.8^2 = ~5 uW.
sky130_expected.reasoning: This is just a single switch and buffer, so it consumes a tiny fraction of the total 56 mW reported for the entire ADC.

step3_testbench.description: Transient analysis to measure the clock buffer delay, output voltage swing, and power consumption at 80 MHz.
step3_testbench.spice:
* Testbench for SC switch and buffer
.lib "${SKY130_PDK}" tt

.param W_xm1=5u L_xm1=0.5u
.param W_xm2=5u L_xm2=0.5u
.param W_xm3=5u L_xm3=0.5u
.param W_xm4=5u L_xm4=0.5u
.param W_xm5=5u L_xm5=0.5u
.param W_xm6=5u L_xm6=0.5u

XM1 N2 LABEL_NET_1 LABEL_NET_0 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm1} w={W_xm1}
XM2 N0 N1 GND GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm2} w={W_xm2}
XM3 N2 LABEL_NET_2 GND GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm3} w={W_xm3}
XM4 VDD LABEL_NET_3 N3 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm4} w={W_xm4}
XM5 N0 N1 N3 VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm5} w={W_xm5}
XM6 LABEL_NET_4 N0 LABEL_NET_5 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm6} w={W_xm6}

* DC Sources
VVDD VDD 0 1.8
VLABEL_NET_3 LABEL_NET_3 0 1.8
VLABEL_NET_4 LABEL_NET_4 0 0.9
VLABEL_NET_0 LABEL_NET_0 0 0.9

* 80 MHz Clocks (T = 12.5ns)
VCLK N1 0 PULSE(0 1.8 0 100p 100p 6.15n 12.5n)
VCLK1 LABEL_NET_1 0 PULSE(0 1.8 0 100p 100p 6.15n 12.5n)
VCLK2 LABEL_NET_2 0 PULSE(1.8 0 0 100p 100p 6.15n 12.5n)

* Load capacitors to simulate next stage
C1 LABEL_NET_5 0 1p
C2 N2 0 1p

.control
tran 50p 50n

* Measure buffer delay (N1 fall -> N0 rise)
meas tran delay_rise trig v(N1) val=0.9 fall=1 targ v(N0) val=0.6 rise=1
* Measure buffer delay (N1 rise -> N0 fall)
meas tran delay_fall trig v(N1) val=0.9 rise=1 targ v(N0) val=0.6 fall=1

* Measure max voltage of buffered clock
meas tran v_n0_max max v(N0)

* Measure power consumption
let power = -i(VVDD)*1.8
meas tran avg_power avg power

print delay_rise delay_fall v_n0_max avg_power
quit
.endc
